entities.name: Amlodipine for CKD BP
observations: In diabetes with albuminuric CKD and BP above goal despite maximally tolerated ACE inhibition, a dihydropyridine calcium-channel blocker such as amlodipine is an appropriate add-on for BP control.
Do not routinely use SGLT2 inhibitors for kidney protection in type 1 diabetes; DKA risk and type 2 evidence should not be extrapolated.
Avoid ACE inhibitor plus ARB combination because harms outweigh benefit.
